families.name: prisma
families.note: The CLI generates the client that @prisma/client loads and @prisma/adapter-pg drives, and Prisma publishes the three at one version within minutes of each other (7.9.1 on 2026-07-27, 7.10.0 on 2026-08-25, registry times), so they move in one change. Only the CLI's freshness is measured; the family is checked for lockstep.

families.name: eslint
families.note: @eslint/js is ESLint's own recommended rule set, released from the same repository at the same version as eslint, and the hold rows of both in SECURITY_CANON move them in one pull request; declaring the family turns that convention into a check (review-suggestions-book SB-212).

families.name: size-limit
families.note: The preset is size-limit's plugin bundle, published at the same version minutes apart (14.2.0 on 2026-10-07), and the two root literals move together; declaring the family turns that convention into a check (review-suggestions-book SB-212).

families.name: typescript-eslint
families.note: The parser and the plugin are published together from one repository at one version, the plugin peers the parser at its own version (^8.71.2 at 8.71.2, read from the registry), and ADR-0018 keeps the parser in the catalog (two manifests) while the plugin stays a root literal (one manifest), so their lockstep was a convention the hold rows describe; declaring the family turns it into a check (review p12, R3-catalog-literal-drift, 2026-10-21).
